_doc: Pinned public sources. sha256 is checked on every fetch; a mismatch is an error, never silently accepted. OSF sha256 values are the ones OSF publishes in its file API; openpsychometrics publishes none, so the value is the one observed on first fetch 2026-10-15. license_status is the observed record status, not a judgement: explicit-license | public-domain-statement | host-terms-no-project-license | no-explicit-license. public_output says what this repository distributes from the source: rows are never redistributed, and aggregates are rebuilt locally by the user.
